Marhala-war Qayamat: Zameen apne neeche se upar tak kapkapane lagegi aur jitne murde is mein hain sab nikal phenkegi. Jaise aur jagah hai (Ya ayyuhan-nasut-taqu Rabbakum, inna zalzalatas-sa'ati shai'un 'azeem) (Surah Al-Hajj: 1) Logo apne Rabb se daro yaqeen mano ke Qayamat ka zalzala us din ka bhunchal badi cheez hai. Aur jagah irshad hai (Wa izal-ardu muddat) (Surah Al-Inshiqaq: 3) Jabke zameen kheench khanch kar barabar hamwar kardi jayegi aur is mein jo kuch hai woh ise bahar daal degi aur bilkul khali ho jayegi. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain zameen apne kaleje ke tukdon ko ugal degi, sona chandi misl sutoonon ke bahar nikal padega. Qatil ise dekh kar afsos karta hua kahega ke haye isi maal ke liye main ne falan ko qatl kiya tha, aaj yeh yun idhar udhar bikhar raha hai koi aankh bhar kar dekhta bhi nahin. Isi tarah sila-rehmi todne wala bhi kahega ke isi ki mohabbat mein aa kar rishtedaron se main sulook nahin karta tha. Chor bhi kahega ke isi ki mohabbat mein main ne haath katwa diye the. Garz woh maal yunhi bikhra phirega koi nahin lega. Insaan us waqt hakka bakka reh jayega aur kahega yeh to hilne julne wali na thi balkeh thehri hui bojhal aur jami hui thi, ise kya ho gaya ke yun bed ki tarah tharane lagi? Aur sath hi jab dekhega ke tamam pehli pichli lashein bhi zameen ne ugal dein to aur hairan-o-pareshan ho jayega ke aakhir ise kya ho gaya hai? Pas zameen bilkul badal di jayegi aur aasman bhi aur sab log us Qahhar Allah ke samne khade ho jayenge. Zameen khule taur par saaf saaf gawahi degi ke falan falan shakhs ne falan falan zyadati is shakhs par ki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya jante bhi ho ke zameen ki bayan karda khabrein kya hongi? Logon ne kaha Allah Ta'ala aur uske Rasool hi ko ilm hai, to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo jo a'maal Bani Adam ne zameen par kiye hain woh tamam woh zahir kar degi ke falan falan shakhs ne falan neki ya badi falan jagah falan waqt ki hai.

Imam Tirmidhi is hadith ko Hasan Sahih Gharib batlate hain. Mu'jam Tabrani mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Zameen se bacho, yeh tumhari maa hai, jo shakhs jo neki ya badi is par karta hai, yeh sab khol khol kar bayan kar degi. Yahan 'wahi' se murad hukm dena hai. 'Auha' aur is ke hum-mani af'aal ka sila harf-e-laam bhi aata hai, 'ila' bhi. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ise farmayega ke bata, aur woh batati jayegi. Is din log hisab ki jagah se mukhtalif qismon ki jamatein ban ban kar lautenge, koi bad hoga, koi nek, koi jannati bana hoga, koi jahannami. Ye ma'ni bhi hain ke yahan se jo alag alag honge to phir ijtima na hoga. Yeh is liye ke woh apne a'maal ko jaan lein aur bhalai burai ka badla pa lenge. Isi liye aakhir mein bhi bayan farma diya. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke ghoron wale teen qism ke hain: ek ajar paane wala, ek parda poshi wala, aur ek bojh aur gunah wala. Ajar wala to woh hai jo ghora palta hai Jihad ki niyat se, agar is ke ghore ki agaari-pichaari dheeli ho gayi aur yeh idhar udhar se charta raha to yeh bhi ghore wale ke liye ajar ka baa'is hai. Aur agar is ki rassi toot gayi aur yeh idhar udhar chala gaya to is ke nishan-e-qadam aur leed ka bhi ise sawab milta hai. Agar yeh kisi nehar par ja kar pani pee le, chahe pilane ka irada na ho, to bhi sawab mil jata hai. Yeh ghora to is ke liye sarasar ajar-o-sawab hai. Dusra woh shakhs jis ne is liye paal rakha hai ke dusron se be-parwah rahe aur kisi se sawal ki zarurat na ho, lekin Allah ka haq na to khud is baar mein bhoolta hai na is ki sawari mein, pas yeh is ke liye parda hai. Teesra woh shakhs hai jis ne fakhr-o-riya-kari aur zulm-o-sitam ke liye paal rakha hai, pas yeh is ke zimma bojh aur is par gunah ka baar hai. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ) se sawal hua ke gadhon ke bare mein kya hukm hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Mujh par Allah Ta'ala ki janib se siwaye tanha aur jame' aayat ke aur kuch nazil nahin hua ke zarra barabar neki ya badi har shakhs dekh lega (Muslim). Hazrat Sa'sa'a bin Malik (R.A) ne to Huzoor (ﷺ) ki zabani yeh aayat sun kar keh diya tha ke sirf yahi aayat kaafi hai aur zyada agar na bhi sunoon to koi zarurat nahin (Musnad-e-Ahmad-o-Nasa'i). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein barwayat Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) marwi hai ke aag se bacho agarche aadhi khajoor ka sadqa hi ho. Isi tarah sahih hadith mein hai ke neki ke kaam ko halka na samjho, go itna hi kaam ho ke tu apne dol mein se zara sa pani kisi pyase ko pilwa de ya apne kisi Musalman bhai se kushaada-ruyi aur khanda-peshani se mulaqat kar le. Dusri ek sahih hadith mein hai ke sa'il ko kuch na kuch de do, go jala hua khur hi ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: Ae Ayesha! Gunahon ko haqeer na samjho, yaad rakho ke in ka bhi hisab lene wala hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke sath khana kha rahe the ke yeh aayat utri to Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne khane se hath utha liya aur puchne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Kya main ek ek zarre barabar ka badla diya jaunga? To Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Siddiq! Duniya mein jo jo takleefein tumhein pahunchi hain, yeh to is mein aa gayin aur nekiyan tumhare liye Allah ke haan zakhira bani hui hain aur in sab ka pura pura badla Qayamat ke din tumhein diya jayega. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh Surah Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ki maujudgi mein nazil hui thi, Aap (R.A) ise sun kar bahut roye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sabab pucha to Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: Mujhe yeh Surah rula rahi hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Agar tum khata aur gunah na karte ke tumhein bakhsha jaye aur maaf kiya jaye to Allah Ta'ala kisi aur ummat ko paida karta jo khata aur gunah karte aur Allah unhein bakhshta. Pucha: Aur chhote chhote bhi? Farmaya: Haan. Maine kaha: Haye afsos! Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Abu Saeed! Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain: Jab aayat 'Wa yut'imun-at-ta'ama ala hubbihi' (76:8) nazil hui, yani maal ki mohabbat ke bawajood maskeen, yateem aur qaidi ko khana khilate hain, to log yeh samajh gaye ke agar hum thodi si cheez rah-e-Allah denge to koi sawab na milega. Maskeen un ke darwaze par aata lekin ek aadh khajoor ya roti ka tukda wagaira dene ko haqarat khayal kar ke yunhi lauta dete the ke agar dein to koi achi mehboob-o-marghoob cheez dein. Idhar to is khayal ki ek jamaat thi, dusri jamaat woh thi jinhein yeh khayal paida ho gaya tha ke chhote chhote gunahon par hamari pakad na hogi, maslan kabhi koi jhoot baat keh di, kabhi idhar udhar nazrein daal lein, kabhi ghibat kar li wagaira. Jahannam ki wa'eed to kabeera gunahon par hai. To yeh aayat 'Faman ya'mal' nazil hui aur unhein bataya gaya ke chhoti si neki ko haqeer na samjho, yeh badi ho kar milegi aur thode se gunah ko bhi be-jaan na samjho, kahin thoda thoda mil kar bahut na ban jaye. Zarra ke ma'ni chhoti chyunty ke hain, yani nekiyon aur buraiyon ko chhoti se chhoti aur badi se badi apne nama-e-a'maal mein dekh lega. Badi to ek hi likhi jati hai, neki ek ke badle das, balki jis ke liye Allah chahe is se bhi bahut zyada, balki in nekiyon ke badle buraiyan bhi maaf ho jati hain, ek ek ke badle das das buraiyan maaf ho jati hain. Phir yeh bhi hai ke jis ki neki burai se ek zarre ke barabar badh gayi woh jannati ho gaya. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Gunahon ko halka na samjha karo, yeh sab jama ho kar aadmi ko halak kar dalte hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne in buraiyon ki misal bayan ki ke jaise kuch log kisi jagah utre, phir ek ek do do lakriyan chun laye to lakriyon ka dher lag jayega, phir agar unhein sulgaya jaye to us waqt is aag par jo chahein paka sakte hain (isi tarah thode thode gunah bahut zyada ho kar aag ka kaam karte hain aur insaan ko jala dete hain). Surah Iza Zulzilat ki tafsir khatam hui, Falhamdulillah.

Marhala-war Qayamat: Zameen apne neeche se upar tak kapkapane lagegi aur jitne murde is mein hain sab nikal phenkegi. Jaise aur jagah hai (Ya ayyuhan-nasut-taqu Rabbakum, inna zalzalatas-sa'ati shai'un 'azeem) (Surah Al-Hajj: 1) Logo apne Rabb se daro yaqeen mano ke Qayamat ka zalzala us din ka bhunchal badi cheez hai. Aur jagah irshad hai (Wa izal-ardu muddat) (Surah Al-Inshiqaq: 3) Jabke zameen kheench khanch kar barabar hamwar kardi jayegi aur is mein jo kuch hai woh ise bahar daal degi aur bilkul khali ho jayegi. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain zameen apne kaleje ke tukdon ko ugal degi, sona chandi misl sutoonon ke bahar nikal padega. Qatil ise dekh kar afsos karta hua kahega ke haye isi maal ke liye main ne falan ko qatl kiya tha, aaj yeh yun idhar udhar bikhar raha hai koi aankh bhar kar dekhta bhi nahin. Isi tarah sila-rehmi todne wala bhi kahega ke isi ki mohabbat mein aa kar rishtedaron se main sulook nahin karta tha. Chor bhi kahega ke isi ki mohabbat mein main ne haath katwa diye the. Garz woh maal yunhi bikhra phirega koi nahin lega. Insaan us waqt hakka bakka reh jayega aur kahega yeh to hilne julne wali na thi balkeh thehri hui bojhal aur jami hui thi, ise kya ho gaya ke yun bed ki tarah tharane lagi? Aur sath hi jab dekhega ke tamam pehli pichli lashein bhi zameen ne ugal dein to aur hairan-o-pareshan ho jayega ke aakhir ise kya ho gaya hai? Pas zameen bilkul badal di jayegi aur aasman bhi aur sab log us Qahhar Allah ke samne khade ho jayenge. Zameen khule taur par saaf saaf gawahi degi ke falan falan shakhs ne falan falan zyadati is shakhs par ki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya jante bhi ho ke zameen ki bayan karda khabrein kya hongi? Logon ne kaha Allah Ta'ala aur uske Rasool hi ko ilm hai, to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo jo a'maal Bani Adam ne zameen par kiye hain woh tamam woh zahir kar degi ke falan falan shakhs ne falan neki ya badi falan jagah falan waqt ki hai.

Imam Tirmidhi is hadith ko Hasan Sahih Gharib batlate hain. Mu'jam Tabrani mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Zameen se bacho, yeh tumhari maa hai, jo shakhs jo neki ya badi is par karta hai, yeh sab khol khol kar bayan kar degi. Yahan 'wahi' se murad hukm dena hai. 'Auha' aur is ke hum-mani af'aal ka sila harf-e-laam bhi aata hai, 'ila' bhi. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala ise farmayega ke bata, aur woh batati jayegi. Is din log hisab ki jagah se mukhtalif qismon ki jamatein ban ban kar lautenge, koi bad hoga, koi nek, koi jannati bana hoga, koi jahannami. Ye ma'ni bhi hain ke yahan se jo alag alag honge to phir ijtima na hoga. Yeh is liye ke woh apne a'maal ko jaan lein aur bhalai burai ka badla pa lenge. Isi liye aakhir mein bhi bayan farma diya. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke ghoron wale teen qism ke hain: ek ajar paane wala, ek parda poshi wala, aur ek bojh aur gunah wala. Ajar wala to woh hai jo ghora palta hai Jihad ki niyat se, agar is ke ghore ki agaari-pichaari dheeli ho gayi aur yeh idhar udhar se charta raha to yeh bhi ghore wale ke liye ajar ka baa'is hai. Aur agar is ki rassi toot gayi aur yeh idhar udhar chala gaya to is ke nishan-e-qadam aur leed ka bhi ise sawab milta hai. Agar yeh kisi nehar par ja kar pani pee le, chahe pilane ka irada na ho, to bhi sawab mil jata hai. Yeh ghora to is ke liye sarasar ajar-o-sawab hai. Dusra woh shakhs jis ne is liye paal rakha hai ke dusron se be-parwah rahe aur kisi se sawal ki zarurat na ho, lekin Allah ka haq na to khud is baar mein bhoolta hai na is ki sawari mein, pas yeh is ke liye parda hai. Teesra woh shakhs hai jis ne fakhr-o-riya-kari aur zulm-o-sitam ke liye paal rakha hai, pas yeh is ke zimma bojh aur is par gunah ka baar hai. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ) se sawal hua ke gadhon ke bare mein kya hukm hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Mujh par Allah Ta'ala ki janib se siwaye tanha aur jame' aayat ke aur kuch nazil nahin hua ke zarra barabar neki ya badi har shakhs dekh lega (Muslim). Hazrat Sa'sa'a bin Malik (R.A) ne to Huzoor (ﷺ) ki zabani yeh aayat sun kar keh diya tha ke sirf yahi aayat kaafi hai aur zyada agar na bhi sunoon to koi zarurat nahin (Musnad-e-Ahmad-o-Nasa'i). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein barwayat Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) marwi hai ke aag se bacho agarche aadhi khajoor ka sadqa hi ho. Isi tarah sahih hadith mein hai ke neki ke kaam ko halka na samjho, go itna hi kaam ho ke tu apne dol mein se zara sa pani kisi pyase ko pilwa de ya apne kisi Musalman bhai se kushaada-ruyi aur khanda-peshani se mulaqat kar le. Dusri ek sahih hadith mein hai ke sa'il ko kuch na kuch de do, go jala hua khur hi ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: Ae Ayesha! Gunahon ko haqeer na samjho, yaad rakho ke in ka bhi hisab lene wala hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke sath khana kha rahe the ke yeh aayat utri to Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne khane se hath utha liya aur puchne lage ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Kya main ek ek zarre barabar ka badla diya jaunga? To Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Siddiq! Duniya mein jo jo takleefein tumhein pahunchi hain, yeh to is mein aa gayin aur nekiyan tumhare liye Allah ke haan zakhira bani hui hain aur in sab ka pura pura badla Qayamat ke din tumhein diya jayega. Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh Surah Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ki maujudgi mein nazil hui thi, Aap (R.A) ise sun kar bahut roye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sabab pucha to Aap (R.A) ne farmaya: Mujhe yeh Surah rula rahi hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Agar tum khata aur gunah na karte ke tumhein bakhsha jaye aur maaf kiya jaye to Allah Ta'ala kisi aur ummat ko paida karta jo khata aur gunah karte aur Allah unhein bakhshta. Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh aayat sun kar pucha ke Huzoor (ﷺ)! Kya mujhe apne sab a'maal dekhne parenge? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Haan. Pucha: Bade bade? Farmaya: Haan. Pucha: Aur chhote chhote bhi? Farmaya: Haan. Maine kaha: Haye afsos! Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Abu Saeed! Khush ho jao, neki to das gune se le kar saat sau gune tak, balki is se bhi zyada tak Allah jise chahe dega, haan gunah isi ke misl honge ya Allah Ta'ala ise bhi bakhsh dega. Suno!
